doc: Reviewed allowlist of non-canonical tokens in verdict-position keys of committed reports/**/*.json. Canonical six statuses are implicit (optionally followed by a free-text qualifier). Targets: the six statuses, NON_VERDICT (descriptor, not a verdict), or OPEN (producer meaning undecided; open finding for the owning leaf). No extra token may map to PASS; a refusal may only map to NOT_RUN/NO_VERDICT/BLOCKED/FAIL. Entries match a whole value or a value-prefix ending at whitespace, '(' or ':'. This establishes vocabulary conformance only.

ALL-CONTROLS-OK.reason: Negative-control outcome label: says the injected defect was caught by the check it targets, not that the subject passed; deliberately not mapped to PASS.

CONTROL-OK.reason: Negative-control outcome label: says the injected defect was caught by the check it targets, not that the subject passed; deliberately not mapped to PASS.

AT-SENSITIVITY-FLOOR.reason: Text says budget NOT met but the producer's intended verdict class is undecided; open finding for the owning leaf (SXT-028e-sse).

AVAILABLE.reason: Tool/oracle availability descriptor, not a verification result.

RUNNABLE.reason: Leg-runnable descriptor, not a verification result.

CORRECTED.reason: Named-tool resolution state; meaning (resolved vs. still failing) not decided here.

DRAFT-NOT-FROZEN.reason: Freeze-stage descriptor; the record is explicitly not a support/fidelity claim.

ESTIMATE.reason: Measurement-kind label (arithmetic estimate), not a verdict.

FINDING.reason: Finding record; whether it is a pass/fail-class result is the owning leaf's call.

MATCH.reason: Could be misread as PASS; comparison semantics (budgeted vs exact) undeclared; owning leaf SXT-028e-sse.

MISMATCH.reason: Could be misread as a verdict; comparison semantics undeclared; owning leaf SXT-028e-sse.

MEASURED.reason: Measurement-kind label (value was measured), not a verdict.

OK.reason: Bare OK is ambiguous with PASS; tool-resolution check in SXT-036 left to the owning leaf.

PLAN-ONLY.reason: Planning-artifact descriptor; explicitly not a support or quality claim.

RECORDED.reason: Record-keeping descriptor for a finding, not a verdict.

REFUSED.reason: A harness refusal produces no comparison; it is not a pass and not a measured FAIL.

REFUSED-STALE.reason: Stale-pin refusal: the comparator declined to run; not a pass.

RESOLVED.reason: Boundary-resolution state descriptor (effect-settle audit), not a verdict.

UNRESOLVED.reason: Boundary-resolution state descriptor (effect-settle audit), not a verdict.

VERIFIED.reason: Bare VERIFIED is ambiguous with PASS (SXT-028-rng source inventory); owning leaf to decide.

[PENDING-SXT-016].reason: Placeholder marker for a cost value pending SXT-016; not a verdict.

adapted-not-predicted.reason: Preset coverage classification (census/prediction), not a verification status.

supported.reason: Preset coverage classification; per CLAUDE.md not a support claim by itself.

unsupported.reason: Preset coverage classification, not a verification status.

unresolved.reason: Preset coverage classification, not a verification status.

analysis_failure.reason: Negative-control analysis outcome; meaning (FAIL vs NOT_RUN) undecided; owning leaf SXT-015.

fit.reason: Word-limit fit descriptor in SXT-015 examples; verdict class undecided.

rejected.reason: Word-limit rejection descriptor in SXT-015; verdict class undecided.

filed.reason: Issue-ledger state descriptor, not a verification status.

landed.reason: Issue-ledger state descriptor, not a verification status.

normalized.reason: Preset normalisation state descriptor, not a verdict.

class_state_unverified.reason: Free-text SXT-028g reconciliation note; verdict class undecided.

CONTROL-OK.reason: Negative-control outcome label: says the injected defect was caught by the check it targets, not that the subject passed; deliberately not mapped to PASS.

BIT-IDENTICAL.reason: Row verdict in sxt-014 deltas; could be misread as PASS; owning leaf to decide.

MEASURABLE-DIFFERENCE.reason: Row verdict in sxt-014 deltas; owning leaf to decide.

NOT REPRODUCIBLE.reason: SXT-028-rng seed-reproducibility verdict; FAIL-vs-finding class undecided.

NO_VERDICT_UNPRICED_COMPONENTS.reason: Token name states NO_VERDICT with the reason (unpriced components).

OVERFLOW_CONCLUSIVE.reason: sxt-017 grid-cell outcome; verdict class undecided.

OVERFLOW_PLACEHOLDER_DEPENDENT.reason: sxt-017 grid-cell outcome; verdict class undecided.

PARTIAL.reason: SXT-028e-sse partial-budget outcome; verdict class undecided.

REFUSED.reason: A harness refusal produces no comparison; it is not a pass.

no reseed call site reachable.reason: Free-text source-inventory observation, not a verdict.
